observations: Two photos show large stacks of used (tokumbo) tires piled outdoors on a stone/tiled surface, under a makeshift shelter.
Tires have visible tread wear patterns, some discoloration, and paint markings (red, yellow dots) typical of imported used-tire sorting marks.
No visible brand name, size markings (e.g. 205/55R16), or DOT date codes legible on any sidewall in either photo.
Foreground tires in both photos appear to be the same or similar stack, shot from slightly different angles.
Watermark 'IKWE ANTHONY' overlays both images, consistent with a reseller's listing photos rather than manufacturer or original owner photos.

identity.kind: used (tokumbo) car tires, size and brand unknown

claims.evidence: Photos show used tires consistent with 'tokumbo' (secondhand import) claim, but no import documentation or origin marking is visible to confirm 'direct' sourcing.

risks.risk: Tire size (width/aspect/rim diameter) unknown, which is the primary price determinant for tires
risks.proof: Close-up photo of sidewall showing full size code, e.g. 205/55R16
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced at any worst case without size

risks.risk: Brand/model of tire unknown (affects value significantly between budget and premium brands)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of sidewall brand logo

risks.risk: Tread depth insufficient or uneven wear not clear from distance shots
risks.proof: Close-up photo with a tread depth gauge or coin inserted in groove

risks.risk: Tire age (DOT date code) unknown; old rubber can be unsafe regardless of tread
risks.proof: Photo of DOT code on sidewall

risks.risk: Hidden sidewall cracks, bulges, or repair patches not visible in wide shots
risks.proof: Close-up photos of full sidewall circumference for each tire being sold

risks.risk: Buyer may not receive the exact tires shown (stock photo of general inventory vs specific set)
risks.proof: Photo/video of the actual tires being set aside for this buyer with matching marks
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified match to listing photos

proof_requests: Close-up photo of sidewall showing full size code (width/aspect/rim diameter)
Close-up photo of brand name on sidewall
Tread depth gauge or coin photo on at least 2-3 tires
Photo of the specific tires set aside for sale, not general stock
response.reason: Tire size is unreadable in both photos and is the dominant factor in tire pricing, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without it.
